headline: The web
is changing.
scenes.eyebrow: A new way to use the web
scenes.provenance: Illustrative concept · Not recorded actions or a website capture
scenes.voiceover: The web is changing. People increasingly set goals and ask agents to navigate. Developers need a way to see how their websites support that interaction.

headline: Meet
Agent Readiness.
body: A feedback loop for websites and agents.
scenes.provenance: Product workflow concept · No Meta production-agent integration
scenes.voiceover: Meet Agent Readiness. Scan a website, inspect agent behavior, explore an improvement, and compare the results.

headline: See what
agents
actually do.
scenes.provenance: Recorded evidence · Observations are not causal diagnoses
scenes.voiceover: This is {evidence.label}. The selected task is: {evidence.featured.question} The public archive supplies {evidence.featured.event_count} selected events for this task. The highlighted event says: {evidence.featured.focus.text} A browser-tool interaction is not a verified website defect.

headline: Turn observations
into action.
scenes.provenance: Illustrative layout · Not a captured website or page diff
scenes.voiceover: The intervention here was owner-selected, not an independently verified recommendation. The concept illustrates bringing existing deposit, minimum-hire, and delivery terms onto listing cards. No website capture or rental value is invented.

headline: See what changed.
scenes.voiceover: In this recorded comparison, the original arm had {evidence.original.supported} evidence-supported passes out of {evidence.task_count}; the modified arm had {evidence.modified.supported}. Requests went from {evidence.original.requests} to {evidence.modified.requests}: {evidence.request_change_label}. The frozen verdict is {evidence.verdicts.frozen}; exploratory verdict, {evidence.verdicts.exploratory}. Website improvement was not established.

headline: Ready for the
agentic web.
scenes.voiceover: Agent Readiness is infrastructure for developers building for the agentic web: a feedback loop grounded in observed behavior and measured outcomes.
